title: Invitation revocation body
description: The organisation that signed a fleet invitation (register row DK1505; spec-delta S1706) takes it back before it is used. Issued by the organisation of the fleet (invitation_revocation_not_the_org); the fleet is declared (invitation_revocation_unknown_fleet); the invitation is named by its nonce, which has not been used (invitation_revocation_already_used) and has not been revoked (invitation_revocation_known). After it the log refuses a passport that carries that invitation (invitation_revoked); other invitations of the fleet are not touched. A used invitation cannot be revoked: the agent has joined, and leaving is the sponsor's passport update. Subject: the fleet. Chain: none (prev is null).

nonce.description: The nonce of the invitation, as it appears in the token (a random string of 8 to 64 URL-safe characters).
